1.text: Yakobo yubura amaso, arebye abona Esawu azanye n'abantu magana ane. Agabanya abana, aha Leya abe, na Rasheli abe, n'inshoreke zombi abazo.

2.text: Ashyira imbere inshoreke n'abana bazo, akurikizaho Leya n'abana be, basezererwa na Rasheli na Yosefu.

3.text: Maze ubwe abarangaza imbere, yikubita hasi karindwi, arinda agera aho yegereye mwene se.

4.text: Esawu arirukanka ajya kumusanganira, aramuhobera begamiranya amajosi, aramusoma, bombi bararira.

5.text: Esawu yubura amaso abona ba bagore n'abana, aramubaza ati “Abo muri kumwe bariya ni abahe?”Aramusubiza ati “Abo ni abana Imana yahereye umugaragu wawe ubuntu bwayo.”

6.text: Maze za nshoreke zīgira hafi zo n'abana bazo, bikubita hasi.

7.text: Na Leya n'abana be bigira hafi, bikubita hasi, hakurikiraho Yosefu na Rasheli, bigira hafi, bikubita hasi.

8.text: Aramubaza ati “Umukumbi twahuye wose ni uw'iki?”Aramusubiza ati “Ni ukugira ngo nkugirireho umugisha, databuja.”

9.text: Esawu aramusubiza ati “Ibyo mfite birahagije. Mwana wa data, ibyo ufite ubyiharire.”

10.text: Yakobo aramubwira ati “Oya ndakwinginze, niba nkugiriyeho umugisha, emera impano nguhaye, kuko mbonye mu maso hawe nk'uko umuntu abona mu maso h'Imana, ukanezererwa.

11.text: Ndakwinginze, emera impano yanjye bakuzaniye, kuko Imana yampereye ubuntu, kandi mfite ibinkwiriye byose.” Aramugomēra, arayemera.

12.text: Aramubwira ati “Dukomeze urugendo tugende, nanjye ndakujya imbere.”

13.text: Aramubwira ati “Databuja, uzi yuko abana badafite imbaraga kandi ko imikumbi n'amashyo mfite byonsa, babigendesha uruhato, naho waba umunsi umwe gusa, byapfa byose.

14.text: Ndakwinginze databuja, ujye imbere y'umugaragu wawe, nanjye ndagenda buhoro, nk'uko kugenda kw'amatungo nshoreye kuri, kandi nk'uko kugenda kw'abana kuri, ngusange databuja, i Seyiri.”

15.text: Esawu aramusubiza ati “Reka ngusigire bamwe mu bo turi kumwe.”Yakobo aramubaza ati “Ni ab'iki? Nkugirireho umugisha databuja.”

16.text: Nuko Esawu uwo munsi asubirayo, agumya kugenda, ajya i Seyiri.

17.text: Yakobo ajya i Sukoti yubakayo inzu, acirayo amatungo ye ibirāro. Ni cyo cyatumye aho hantu hitwa i Sukoti.

18.text: Yakobo asohora amahoro mu mudugudu Shekemu, wo mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni, ubwo yavaga i Padanaramu, abamba amahema imbere y'umudugudu.

19.text: Isambu yabambyeho ihema rye ayigura na bene Hamori, se wa Shekemu, ibice by'ifeza ijana.
